offset.description: The next offset to use for pagination (result of limit + offset)

userStatuses.description: Map of hiveId to the current user's reading status for that book. Only present when authenticated.

q.description: Search query string. Will be matched against title and authors fields.

id.description: The ID of the book within the hive.

genre.description: Filter by genre. Returns books in that genre. Can be used with or without q.

offset.description: Offset for pagination into the result set

main.description: Find books matching the search criteria. Does not require authentication.
